title: EnvironmentRelease
description: The fifth pinned evaluation input. Results depend on library versions, BLAS, thread count and reduction order, so an unpinned environment makes the central invariant unenforceable (ADR-0021, superseding ADR-0009).

thread_counts.description: Pinned because reduction order under multithreaded BLAS is not deterministic. The only object in this set permitting additional properties: the set of relevant variables is set by the libraries installed, not by this contract.

container_digest.description: null where no container was used. ADR-0016's image is authored but unbuilt, so this is null in practice today.

platform.description: RECORDED, NOT PINNED. Bit-identity across CPU architectures cannot be guaranteed, and claiming it would be an unsupported assertion. Platform difference is what separates reproduction class EXACT from EQUIVALENT.
